content_sections.heading: SAIRD Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SAIRD Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SAIRD Job 2026 Employment News Paper Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: SAIRD Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Scientist cum-Head KVK: Doctoral degree in relevant subject including relevant basic sciences with 8 years' experience in the relevant subject as Scientist/Lecturer/Extension Specialist or equivalent position in the pay band-3 of Rs. 15600-39100 with Grade pay of Rs. 5400/Rs. 6000/Rs. 7000/Rs. 8000/ having made contribution to research/teaching/extension education as evidenced by published work/innovations and impact. Subject Matter Specialist (Livestock Production): Master's Degree in Livestock Production/ Veterinary Sciences / Animal Sciences/ Animal Husbandry/ Veterinary Extension or equivalent qualifications from a recognized university.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SAIRD Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.saird.org. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SAIRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the SAIRD Recruitment 2026 is 03 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SAIRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Senior Scientist cum-Head KVK and Subject Matter Specialist in the Sri Aurobindo Institute of Rural Development Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SAIRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the SAIRD Recruitment 2026, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under SAIRD Recruitment 2026 is 47 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: For Senior Scientist cum-Head KVK, a Doctoral degree with 8 years of experience is required. For Subject Matter Specialist, a Master's Degree in the relevant field is necessary.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Scientist cum-Head KVK post is Level 13 A (Rs. 1,31,400/-), and for Subject Matter Specialist, it is Level 10 (Rs. 56,100/-) as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for SAIRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for SAIRD Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Sri Aurobindo Institute of Rural Development, which is www.saird.org.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located in Suryapet, Telangana, with the pincode 508201.
